integration_requests.request: Add settings/accessibility_service_completion/apply.sh to Settings source preparation after pinned source preparation and before HAP build; use existing --source-root contract. Only the one declared upstream file changes.

Official API26 Settings HAP compile; add new host regression to concentrated checks; validate four actual accessibility notification actions, config/error completion, permissions, continuous requests and extension destruction/restart on the first new representative package. Keep all34 ledger rows open until the whole run passes.

Use per-item findings to assign unique owners for vendor/HAP preinstall/signature wiring and network/telephony/location/media/notification caller contracts. Similar names do not guarantee compatible protocols; no blanket bundle replacements.

Fixed ServiceExtensionContext::TerminateAbility passes token_,-1 with no latest-startId guard. Do not add unconditional async self-termination to this notification service: a new onRequest can arrive while termination is outstanding. Validate existing lifetime and select an atomic/conditional stop contract before claiming idle exit; notification helpers are synchronous setValueSync and need no await.
